symptom: Arm Speed or Power is Low
detail_of_failure: The arm speed is slow or the power is low.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • Arm IN PPC Pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01100) • R pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01101)

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on IN side of arm control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Examine it. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine and Adjust Oil Pressure in Work Equipment, Swing, and Travel Circuits”. 2. Does the troubleshooting result of the main relief pressure agree with the judgment criteria? 3. Examine it. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine parts which cause hydraulic drift of work equipment”. 4. Does the troubleshooting result of hydraulic drift agree with the standard value? 5. Do relief of other work equipment and examine. 6. Is the arm stopped? 7. Interchange the pressure compensation valves on IN and OUT sides of arm control valve, and examine. 8. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce? REMARK The area ratios of the pressure compensation valves on the IN side and OUT sides are different. Be sure to set them back to their initial positions after troubleshooting.
